help.heroSubtitle: Find answers below or chat with Julia, your friendly support companion who is always happy to help.
help.faq.g1.question: What is Dripn?
help.faq.g1.answer: Dripn is your personal fashion decision engine that helps you confidently decide what to wear. Get instant outfit advice from AI stylists with distinct personalities, manage your digital wardrobe, and discover your unique style.
help.faq.g2.question: Which devices support Dripn?
help.faq.g2.answer: Dripn is available on iOS and Android devices through the Expo Go app, and also accessible via web browsers. For the best experience, we recommend using the mobile app.
help.faq.g3.question: How do I get started?
help.faq.g3.answer: Simply create an account, complete our quick style quiz to help us understand your preferences, and start exploring! You can upload your wardrobe, ask your AI stylist for outfit advice, or get a personalised lookbook right away.
help.faq.g4.question: Is there a tutorial available?
help.faq.g4.answer: Yes! When you first open the app, you will see helpful tips. You can also retake the Style Quiz anytime from Settings to update your preferences.
help.faq.a1.question: How do I create an account?
help.faq.a1.answer: You can sign up using your Apple ID, Google account, or email address. Just tap
help.faq.a2.question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
help.faq.a3.question: How do I change my email address?
help.faq.a3.answer: Go to Profile, then Settings, then Edit Profile. You can update your email there. You may need to verify the new email address.
help.faq.a4.question: How do I delete my account?
help.faq.a4.answer: We are sad to see you go! To delete your account, go to Settings, then scroll to Account, then Delete Account. Please note this action is permanent and cannot be undone.
help.faq.a5.question: Can I have multiple accounts?
help.faq.a5.answer: We recommend using one account to get the most personalized experience. Our AI learns your style preferences over time, so keeping one account helps us serve you better.
help.faq.s1.question: What subscription plans are available?
help.faq.s1.answer: We offer three plans: Free (1 stylist decision per day, 2-option shopping compare, up to 15 wardrobe items), Personal Stylist at £9.99 per month (unlimited decisions, 3-way compare, wardrobe-aware advice, decision history), and Stylist Unlimited at £19.99 per month (outfit calendar, unlimited wardrobe, and full planning tools).
help.faq.s2.question: How do I upgrade my subscription?
help.faq.s2.answer: Go to Settings, then Subscription to view all plans and upgrade. Payments are processed securely through Stripe.
help.faq.s3.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
help.faq.s3.answer: You can cancel anytime from Settings, then Subscription. You will keep access to your current tier features until the end of your billing period.
help.faq.s4.question: Will I get a refund if I cancel?
help.faq.s4.answer: Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis. For any billing concerns, please contact our support team through the Chat with Julia button below, and we will do our best to help.
help.faq.s5.question: My subscription features are not working. What should I do?
help.faq.s5.answer: First, try logging out and back in to refresh your account. If you still have issues, contact Julia below and we will help resolve the problem.
help.faq.ai1.question: How does the AI stylist work?
help.faq.ai1.answer: Our AI stylists (Ruby, Max, Ace, and Ivy) each have unique personalities and styling approaches. They analyze your photos, consider your style preferences, body type, and the occasion to provide personalized outfit advice. The more you use it, the better they understand your taste!
help.faq.ai3.question: How do voice conversations work?
help.faq.ai3.answer: Open Stylist Chat and tap the headphones icon for Voice mode — your stylist speaks replies aloud (uses voice sessions from your plan). In Chat mode, type or tap the mic to dictate; text replies are unlimited on the Personal Stylist plan.
help.faq.ai4.question: What is Color Analysis?
help.faq.ai4.answer: Color Analysis helps you discover which colors complement your skin tone, hair, and eyes. Our AI determines your color season (Spring, Summer, Autumn, or Winter) and recommends the most flattering shades for you.
help.faq.p1.question: What data does Dripn collect?
help.faq.p1.answer: We collect information you provide (profile, wardrobe photos, preferences) and usage data to improve your experience. We never sell your personal data. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
help.faq.p2.question: Are my photos private?
help.faq.p2.answer: Yes! All your wardrobe photos and outfit images are private by default. Photos used for AI features are processed securely and never shared.
help.faq.p3.question: How do I delete my data?
help.faq.p3.answer: You can delete individual items from your wardrobe. To delete all your data, you can request a full data deletion through Settings or by contacting our support team.
help.faq.p4.question: Is my payment information secure?
help.faq.p4.answer: Absolutely. All payments are processed through our secure payment partner Stripe. We never see or store your full payment details.
help.faq.p5.question: Can I download my data?
help.faq.p5.answer: Yes! You can request a copy of your data by contacting our support team. We will prepare your data export within 30 days.
help.faq.t1.question: The app is running slow. What can I do?
help.faq.t1.answer: Try these steps: Close and reopen the app, check your internet connection, clear the app cache in your phone settings, and make sure you have the latest app version installed.
help.faq.t2.question: My photos are not uploading. Help!
help.faq.t2.answer: First, check that Dripn has permission to access your photos (Settings on your phone). Then verify you have a stable internet connection. Try uploading a smaller photo first, and close other apps to free up memory.
help.faq.t3.question: I am not receiving notifications.
help.faq.t3.answer: Go to your phone Settings, find Dripn, and ensure notifications are enabled. Also check that Do Not Disturb is off. In the app, verify notification settings under Profile, then Settings.
help.faq.t4.question: The app crashed! What happened?
help.faq.t4.answer: We are sorry about that! Try force-closing and reopening the app. If crashes persist, try reinstalling the app. Your account data will be preserved. Please report ongoing issues to our support team.
help.faq.t5.question: Features look different on web vs mobile.
help.faq.t5.answer: The web version has some limitations compared to mobile. For the best experience with all features, we recommend using the iOS or Android app through Expo Go.
help.faq.t6.question: I cannot log in with Apple or Google.
help.faq.t6.answer: Make sure you are signed into your Apple or Google account on your device. Try logging out and back in to those accounts. If using web, some browsers may block sign-in popups, so check your popup settings.
